season.evidence: Web search found no stated season for Four Brothers itself; Chikamin Ridge scramble reports from the same trailhead run July through late September, and the stored best month is August. Histogram Jun-Oct low counts; early-June ascents were on steep snow.

track.why: Single stored route on the peak. The September 4 report describes leaving the Glacier Lake trail at its high saddle, class 2 ledges up the ridge to class 3 final 100 ft; the track runs Mineral Creek trailhead, Park Lakes basin, ridge, summit pin (10 m), and back; 109 m from the trailhead pin both ends. The report calls it a side objective on a Chikamin trip, but this track never reaches Chikamin Peak (highest point is the saddle at 47.475 N).

otherTracksConsidered.why: Track climbs to Chikamin Peak (47.4865 N) as well: a link-up, no assignment.
June 15 multi-peak Lemah/Chikamin link-up with no track.
June 15 report coming from the Chikamin saddle by a snow gully from the north-east side; different line, no track.

facts.text: From the high saddle on the Glacier Lake trail, follow the ridge and bear right after about 300 ft of climbing onto class 2 ledges that lead to the crest.
Loose rock sits at the head of the long gully that drops toward Glacier Lake; take care on the ridge above it (early September)
The last 100 ft is class 3: start in the gully on the right, then cross left onto blocky ground near the ridge.
Dropping directly toward Glacier Lake works at class 2, but heather and boulders slow the bottom; it saves little over reversing to the saddle.

notes: 2019686 is a single-report assignment; the owner should treat it as medium confidence because the author framed Four Brothers as part of a Chikamin trip (the track itself is a Four Brothers round trip). Peakbagger's summit coordinate is 151 m from ours; the track passes within 10 m of ours, so no summit move proposed.
